The [[Phoenix (pet)|Phoenix]] is a [[charmable animal]] that can only be found in the [[Divine Path]], which you enter after completing the last Factions mission, the [[Imperial Sanctum]]. One phoenix is at the start of the area, with [[Suun]], the other is further along the path, with the ministers. Two [[Phoenix (Emperor)|adult phoenixes]] next to [[Emperor Kisu]] cannot be charmed.

==Notes==
* The Phoenix is one of three ''rare pets'' with their own statues in the [["Fellowship"]] monument in the [[Hall of Monuments]]; its statue is labeled, ''Imperial Phoenix''. The others are the [[Black Widow]] and the [[Black Moa Bird]].
* When you start [[Imperial Sanctum]], replace [[Charm Animal]] with the [[celestial skill]] during [[Imperial Sanctum]]; it will be reverted back when the mission ends.
* Evolved Phoenixes deal [[piercing damage]], while Unevolved Phoenixes deal [[slashing damage]].
* [[Zaishen Menagerie Grounds/Service costs|Unlocking cost]]: 3{{zgold}} plus 100{{gold}} or 30,000 [[Balthazar Faction]] ''(Prestige, Cantha)''
{{bug|This pet sometimes encounters a bug where it will not be able to be added to the [[Hall of Monuments]]. To fix this, after leveling the Phoenix to 20 go to the [[Zaishen Menagerie]] and talk to [[Emryd the Tamer]] to register your tamed Phoenix. Then, speak to [[Wynn]], tell her you would like to see an animal, the Phoenix will be under "[[Cantha]]". Ask to see a level 20 Elder Phoenix and tame one of the ones that spawned. It should now be able to work in your [[Hall of Monuments]].}}

== Trivia ==
* During their idle animation, they will shake their head to look right and left.
* Their wings make a flapping sound as they move.
* This creature more closely resembles the [[W:Fenghuang|fenghuang]] of Chinese mythology rather than the [[w:Phoenix (mythology)|phoenix]] of European lore.
